requirements.evidence: `app/Models/User.php:35-66` inserts methods inside `casts()` twice and leaves a stray `}`, a parse error; `app/Models/Entity.php:9` imports a non-existent HasFactory; `Settings.php:62` makes `transfer()` always abort 403; `Dashboard.php:25` makes `isOwner` always false; no Blade views (`Dashboard.php:26`, `Members.php:73`, `Settings.php:77`), no lang keys, and no `employee()` factory state (`EntityMembershipFactory.php:20-33`).

conventions.evidence: Policies are used for view/update/delete (`app/Policies/EntityPolicy.php:19-39`), migrations include `down()` (`database/migrations/2026_10_29_000000_create_entities_table.php:20`) and `$fillable` is set (`Entity.php:15`); but there are no `#[Validate]` attributes (`Members.php:22`), no `app/Actions` classes for the new domain writes (`Members.php:37`, `Settings.php:45-69`), no tests, and the docs left stale (`docs/database-schema.md:152-154`).

security.evidence: `Members::addMember()` has no authorization at all (`app/Livewire/Entity/Members.php:30-43`), the enum/string comparison lets the owner membership be deleted (`app/Policies/EntityMembershipPolicy.php:29`), and the settings actions never re-authorize (`Settings.php:33/43/56`). Positives: `assignRole`/`removeMember` do call `authorize` (`Members.php:48,59`) and `entity.pick` checks membership before touching the session (`routes/web.php:16-19`).

tests.evidence: `change.diff` adds no test files: nothing covers the models, policies, routes or pages, and there are no unauthorized-call or tamper tests for any Livewire action.

simplicity.evidence: `app/Models/User.php:35-66` contains two identical copies of `memberships()`, `entities()` and `membershipFor()`, and several imports are unused (`Settings.php:11-12`, `Members.php:12`, `Entity.php:10`); the rest is direct Eloquent/policy code without speculative layers.

readability.evidence: `User.php:35-66` mixes method declarations into `casts()` and duplicates them; the comment at `Members.php:60` describes a guard whose check at `:61` can never be true; enum/string comparisons are inconsistent across `Dashboard.php:25`, `Settings.php:62` and `EntityMembershipPolicy.php:29`.

scope.evidence: `routes/web.php:1-27` replaces the entire route file and deletes the welcome, `/home`, login/register/logout, password-reset and e-mail-verification routes; all other files serve the task.

issues.explanation: The new relation methods are inserted inside `casts()` and then copied again after a stray closing brace at line 50, with duplicate method names, so the file is not valid PHP and the application cannot boot.

Both models import the non-existent `Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\HasFactory` instead of `Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Factories\HasFactory`, and they extend an unimported `Model` that resolves to `App\Models\Model` (not shown in the diff), so the models fail to load.

The whole route file is replaced and the welcome, `/home`, login/register/logout, password-reset and e-mail-verification routes are deleted, breaking existing authentication and leaving no `home` route.

`render()` references `livewire.entity.dashboard`, `livewire.entity.members` and `livewire.entity.settings`, but no Blade views are added, so every new page fails with a view-not-found error and none of the required markup is delivered.

issues.location: lang/pt_BR/ui.php and lang/en/ui.php (absent from the diff)
issues.explanation: No language entries are added for `ui.nav_members`, `ui.nav_settings`, the owner notice or 'Transferir propriedade' / 'Transfer ownership', all of which the task requires in both locales.
`addMember()` never calls `authorize`, so any employee/member can add users to the entity, contradicting 'Employees get 403 on add'.

`role` is cast to the `UserRole` enum, so `$membership->role === UserRole::Owner->value` is always false and the owner's membership can be deleted (including by the owner's own self-removal), contradicting 'never delete the owner's membership'.
Because `$membership->role` is a `UserRole` enum, `$membership->role !== UserRole::Admin->value` is always true, so `transfer()` always aborts 403 and ownership can never be transferred.
`isOwner` compares the enum-cast role to the string value, so it is always false; the owner-only settings link and the owner notice would never render even with a view.
`save()`, `delete()` and `transfer()` depend only on the `mount()` authorization and never call `$this->authorize`, so a demoted or tampering client can still edit, delete or transfer the entity.
`assignRole()` allows targeting the owner membership, so an admin or the owner can demote the sole owner to employee/admin and leave the entity without any owner.

The single-owner constraint is not the required portable stored `owner_seq` generated column: the MySQL branch uses `virtualAs` with the invalid MySQL expression `role = 'owner' ? 1 : NULL` and only runs for the `mysql` driver, while SQLite uses a partial index instead of `owner_seq`.

The last-manager guard compares the enum-cast role to a string (never true) and counts only admins in `$this->entity` rather than owner+admin in the membership's entity, so the last manager can be removed.
`transfer()` never checks whether the caller's owner row still exists (the task requires 403 if it vanished) and demotes via a bulk query without checking that any owner row was affected.
No Pest/PHPUnit tests are added for any model, policy, route or Livewire action, missing the required happy-path, authorization-failure and tamper coverage.
Only the `owner()` and `admin()` states are defined; the required `employee()` state is missing.
`delete()` redirects to `route('home')`, but this same change removes the `/home` route, so deleting an entity throws a RouteNotFoundException after the entity has already been removed.
`assignRole()` resolves the client-supplied membership ID without pinning it to `$this->entity`, letting an admin of another entity modify that entity's memberships from this page.
Public input properties have no `#[Validate]` attributes and `$targetMembershipId` has no `#[Locked]`, deviating from the project's `#[Validate]` pattern and Livewire locking rule.

The docs only add a 'New Tables' block while leaving the stale notes about a non-existent `entities.owner_membership_id` and application-enforced uniqueness, and they claim `owner_seq` exists on both databases.
There are unused imports (`ValidationException`, `Auth`, `DB`, `EntityMembership`-adjacent imports) and `routes/web.php:3` imports the non-existent `Illuminate\Foundation\Auth\routes`.
The new domain writes (add member, role change, entity delete, ownership transfer) are implemented inline in Livewire components rather than through the project's `app/Actions/*` pattern.
Audit-relevant member and entity changes are logged with `Log::info` on the default channel instead of the project's `audit` channel, which the pick route does use.

review.summary: The change adds the entity/membership models, `UserRole` enum, policies, Livewire components, factories, migrations and routes, but it is not mergeable. `User.php` is unparseable, the models import a non-existent `HasFactory`, the entire existing route file (including auth and `/home`) is deleted, and there are no Blade views, language files or tests; authorization and role checks are also broken, with `addMember()` unauthenticated and enum/string comparisons disabling owner protection, the dashboard owner flag and ownership transfer.
